mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and 46 degrees at City Hall. The moon is currently in its First Quarter phase. If you are awake early, the International Space Station will be visible for four minutes starting at 5:42 AM, rising in the sky from the direction of Mount Horeb and heading toward the Madison area near Home Depot.

The big story today is that the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver on October 15 for operating while impaired near Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace. Thankfully, there were no injuries to students or the public. In other updates, the city has updated its zoning and sign ordinances, and residents are reminded to check their polling locations for upcoming elections.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Thursday brings a variety of activities at the ART House and live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard.
On Wednesday, October 15, officers responded to a report of dangerous driving and arrested a bus driver for O W I. An investigation is ongoing regarding a potential collision with a traffic sign.

Today is the perfect day to stop by for a treat, as the flavor of the day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
